title: Brandon Roy
wikitext:
'''Brandon Roy''' is a basketball player from the [[University of Washington]]. After a productive previous three years, he had a breakout senior year where he averaged 20.2 points per game and led the Washington Huskies to a 26-7 season. Roy was rewarded with the [[Pac-10]] Player of the Year award at season's end. A product of [[Garfield High School]] in [[Seattle, Washington]], Roy was instrumental in rebuilding the Husky program under [[Lorenzo Romar]]. During Brandon Roy's 2005-2006 senior season, he led the Huskies to a [[Sweet 16]] appearance and was selected as a [[All-American]] at the seasons end. He is expected to be a lottery pick in the [[2006 NBA Draft]].
